words: A Secret Wallet credit given to a losing or complaining VIP player on Livechat, so they feel looked after. Not every complaint earns one.
The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
A player who asks for free credit again and again with no qualifying reason.
Giving a player two rewards on the same day. Not allowed.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Does this case earn a credit?
items: The player lost a lot this week (a significant loss)
The SW has a balance
No recent credit, and no reward already given today
tour.done: All three: the "losing a lot" case. Carry on to sizing.
tour.notYet: Small loss: validate and suggest a game, no credit. Habitual asker: decline gently and redirect.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps, in this order
items: Acknowledge
Name the feeling first, before any solution.
Check the profile
Loss this week, SW balance, recent credits, abuse or risk tag.
Match the case
Losing a lot: SW credit. Losing little: no credit, suggest a game. Habitual asker: decline gently.
Size and check the gate
Within the tier rule and the monthly allowance. Above the CS limit, route to the ATL.
Issue and message
Issue the SW credit with a kind message and state the validity.
Record
Player, reason, amount, tier, who issued. Tag the case.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Jump to a solution before you acknowledge the emotion.
Promise a credit you cannot confirm. Say "let me check" first.
Go above the tier rule or the monthly allowance.
Stack it with a reward given the same day.

tour.label: Numbers
tour.title: How much
items: The tier rule
[CONFIRM] The SOP says "T3 = 3%, TV = 5%". Those are the SW earn rates. What is the percentage taken of: the SW balance, this week's loss, or something else?
The monthly allowance
[CONFIRM] How is the remaining monthly allowance worked out, and where does CS see it?
Ending in 8
[CONFIRM] Does the ending-in-8 rule and a max apply to compensation too?

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Who can issue it?
tour.q: [CONFIRM] Is the amount above the CS limit (amount to be set by the ATL)?
tour.yes: Route it to the ATL. CS cannot self-issue over the limit.
tour.no: CS issues it, within the tier rule and the monthly allowance.

pool.q: An angry player says they lost everything today. What do you do first?
pool.why: Emotion first. Acknowledge the feeling before any solution, check or redirect.

pool.q: The player lost a small amount, not enough for an SW credit, and is upset. What do you do?
o: Validate the feeling, suggest a game, no credit
Tell them it is their fault
pool.why: Losing little: acknowledge, suggest a fresh game and reframe toward hope. No credit committed.

pool.q: A player asks for free credit every day with no qualifying reason. What do you do?
o: Give it to keep them happy
Decline gently and redirect to a game
pool.why: Decline gently, redirect to a game, and say you will let them know by SMS when there is something. They should still feel looked after.

pool.q: You are not sure the player qualifies for a credit. What do you tell them?
pool.why: Never promise a bonus you cannot deliver. Say "let me check" instead of a false commitment.

pool.q: The player qualifies for compensation but already got a Reload today. What do you do?
pool.why: No stacking with a same-day reward.

pool.q: You issued a compensation credit. What must the record show?
o: Player, reason, amount, tier and who issued it
pool.why: Log player, reason, amount, tier and who issued it, and tag the case. No record means an unverifiable credit.
